execute: Establish a legitimate ceremony and policy for freshness, single use, principal/session, relying party, origin, credential ownership and verification. Distinguish protocol RP ID from vendor application ID. Track which stage creates, changes and consumes each value. Compare one binding axis after a valid normal ceremony; follow the exact credential through persistence, assertion and final usable session. Determine whether an echoed value becomes authoritative state. Record unavailable authenticators, signing material or session prerequisites as blockers. Echoes, status:ok, 500s, count changes or fmt:none alone do not prove a violation; none attestation may be intended policy.
review: Support a binding violation only when the changed value is consumed against policy with normal and rejection controls. Persistence proves its stage, not takeover. A valid rejection refutes that transition; invalid syntax or unavailable normal ceremony is inconclusive. Stop at the required blocker; reopen for changed challenge storage, RP policy, session, credential or consumer evidence.
